notes: Outline redrawn 2026-11-20 under the owner's new rules (edge on paper between the innermost rule and the first map ink; ruled boxes at the margin are notches; no holes; legend/title blocks, compass roses and SECTION badges go in 'remove'). Sides: placed from pixel profiles across the frame at every px along each side (outer bar, white hairline, thin inner rule), on the first 1-2 px of paper inside the thin rule's inner edge, never on the rule or in the hairline; where map ink lies within a few px of the rule the edge runs in the paper gap between them, and where map ink truly touches the rule it follows the rule's inner edge (estimated from the neighbouring clean stretches and the bar's outer edge). Points every 15-50 px, so the bowed rules are followed. Corners (rule 2): the inner edge of the innermost (thin) arc was traced from the scan (circle fit to the measured edge, then the edge measured along the outline), the outline ~1-2 px inside it; where the arc leaves the side rule (a short stub inside the rule) the outline goes round the stub, so the stub stays outside. Kind (b): the cross-hatched blocks on the right side (y ~1450-2760) touch the inner rule and the outline runs along the rule's inner edge over them; on the lower left (y ~2150-2950) the rear line of a narrow lot strip runs 2-4 px inside the rule and the outline keeps to the paper between them, touching it only where it meets the rule; lot and street lines run into the bottom-left arc and the shoreline line into the top-left arc and are cut there; a few lines touch the bottom rule (x ~940-1010). remove: (1) the CITY & COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO / USE OF PROPERTY / ZONE MAP title, LEGEND and scale-bar block (top left over the Presidio; the former 8-point hole, notched at the lower left so the Presidio roads beside the legend boxes stay map; it holds some Presidio paper but no city ink); (2) the SECTION 2 badge (top right, octagon 3-8 px clear of the ring, on paper between the top rule and a pier line). Both kept unchanged from the former holes. No other holes; no ruled box at the margin. 'Join Sec. 3', 'Join Sec. 1' and 'Join Sec. 7' print outside the frame bars. FORT MASON / U.S. MILITARY RESERVATION, LAUREL HILL CEMETERY etc. name places and stay map.
